name: S9018
description: NPN high-frequency transistor in the S901x family, intended for RF/VHF amplifier and oscillator stages (ft ~700-1100MHz). TO-92 pin order is E-B-C, the reverse of European BC-series. No standard complementary PNP.

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: E-B-C left to right. Verified from Fairchild SS9018 and MCC datasheets.

extra.Vbe(on): 1.4V (max) @ Ic=10mA, Ib=1mA (datasheet's VBE(sat); MCC/JCET agree on this value)

typical_application: RF/VHF small-signal amplifier, oscillator and mixer stages in FM and low-band radio circuits; the high-ft member of the S901x jellybean family.
gotchas: pinout is E-B-C, not the European C-B-E
low Vceo (18V) and Vebo (4V); easy to exceed in RF circuits with reactive swings
Pd rating differs by maker (Fairchild ~400mW, MCC ~310mW); derate conservatively
this is the RF member of the family, not interchangeable with the audio S9014/S9013 despite the similar number
